item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 22/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a southerly airstream, it will be humid and foggy over the coast of Guangdong in the next few days, and it will be rather warm during the day. There will be more showers over inland areas. With the southerly airstream being replaced by a weak northeast monsoon midweek next week, temperatures will drop slightly over the coastal areas of southern China. Upper-air disturbances are expected to bring showers and a few thunderstorms to southern China in the latter part of next week.
